2:// 后端 3 接口：upload/init → upload/chunk × N → upload/merge

4:import axios from 'axios'
5:import SparkMD5 from 'spark-md5'
6:import store from './index'
7:import { languageName } from '../i18n'
8:
9:export const CHUNK_THRESHOLD = 10 * 1024 * 1024
10:export const CHUNK_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 必须与后端 ChunkUpload::CHUNK_SIZE 一致
11:const CONCURRENCY = 3
12:const RETRY_MAX = 3
13:const LOCAL_INDEX_PREFIX = 'chunked_upload:'
14:const LOCAL_INDEX_TTL = 24 * 3600 * 1000
15:
16:// 业务错误（非网络），命中立即抛，不浪费重试次数
17:const NON_RETRYABLE_MSGS = new Set([
18:    '上传会话不存在或已过期',
19:    '上传会话归属错误',
20:    '分片序号超出范围',
21:    '分片大小不符合预期',
22:    '末尾分片大小不符合预期',
23:])
24:
25:// hashing 0-5 / uploading 5-95 / merging 95-100
26:function mapProgress(stage, percent) {
27:    if (stage === 'hashing') return Math.round(percent * 0.05)
28:    if (stage === 'uploading') return 5 + Math.round(percent * 0.9)
29:    return 95 + Math.round(percent * 0.05)
30:}
31:
32:/**
33: * @param {Object} opts
34: * @param {File}   opts.file
35: * @param {'file_cabinet'|'dialog_file'|'image'|'generic_file'} opts.scene
36: * @param {Object} [opts.sceneParams]  透传到后端 merge 阶段
37: * @param {(percent:number, stage:'hashing'|'uploading'|'merging') => void} [opts.onProgress]
38: * @param {(uploadId:string) => void} [opts.onStart]  init 拿到 upload_id 后回调，秒传命中不会触发；调用方可据此实现取消
39: * @param {AbortSignal} [opts.signal]
40: * @returns {Promise<Object>}  merge 返回 data（与该 scene 老接口对齐）
41: */
42:export async function chunkedUpload({ file, scene, sceneParams = {}, onProgress, onStart, signal }) {
43:    const cb = typeof onProgress === 'function' ? onProgress : () => {}
44:    const progress = (stage, pct) => cb(mapProgress(stage, pct), stage)
45:
46:    progress('hashing', 0)
47:    const hash = await calcMd5(file, signal, (loaded, total) => {
48:        progress('hashing', Math.min(99, Math.round((loaded / total) * 100)))
49:    })
50:    progress('hashing', 100)
51:    if (signal && signal.aborted) throw new Error('aborted')
52:
53:    const initResp = await callJson('upload/init', {
54:        hash,
55:        size: file.size,
56:        name: file.name,
57:        scene,
58:        scene_params: sceneParams,
59:    }, signal)
60:    if (initResp.ret !== 1) {
61:        throw new Error(initResp.msg || '上传初始化失败')
62:    }
63:    if (initResp.data && initResp.data.done) {
64:        progress('uploading', 100)
65:        progress('merging', 100)
66:        return initResp.data
67:    }
68:    const { upload_id, chunk_size, chunk_count, received } = initResp.data
69:    saveLocalIndex(hash, upload_id, scene)
70:    if (typeof onStart === 'function') {
71:        try { onStart(upload_id) } catch (_e) { /* 调用方异常不阻断上传 */ }
72:    }
73:
74:    const receivedSet = new Set((received || []).map(Number))
75:    const todo = []
76:    for (let i = 0; i < chunk_count; i++) {
77:        if (!receivedSet.has(i)) todo.push(i)
78:    }
79:    let uploadedCount = receivedSet.size
80:    const updateUploading = () => {
81:        progress('uploading', Math.min(99, Math.round((uploadedCount / chunk_count) * 100)))
82:    }
83:    updateUploading()
84:
85:    // cursor 协作：每个 worker 抓下一个 index，避免分片到 worker 的预分配在失败时空闲
86:    let cursor = 0
87:    let firstError = null
88:    const workOne = async () => {
89:        while (true) {
90:            if (firstError) return
91:            if (signal && signal.aborted) {
92:                firstError = new Error('aborted')
93:                return
94:            }
95:            const myCursor = cursor++
96:            if (myCursor >= todo.length) return
97:            const idx = todo[myCursor]
98:            const start = idx * chunk_size
99:            const end = Math.min(start + chunk_size, file.size)
100:            const blob = file.slice(start, end)
101:            try {
102:                await uploadChunkWithRetry(upload_id, idx, blob, signal)
103:                uploadedCount++
104:                updateUploading()
105:            } catch (e) {
106:                if (!firstError) firstError = e
107:                return
108:            }
109:        }
110:    }
111:    const workerCount = Math.min(CONCURRENCY, todo.length || 1)
112:    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workerCount }, () => workOne()))
113:    if (firstError) throw firstError
114:    progress('uploading', 100)
115:
116:    progress('merging', 0)
117:    const mergeResp = await callJson('upload/merge', { upload_id }, signal)
118:    if (mergeResp.ret !== 1) {
119:        throw new Error(mergeResp.msg || '合并失败')
120:    }
121:    progress('merging', 100)
122:    clearLocalIndex(hash)
123:    return mergeResp.data
124:}
125:
126:async function uploadChunkWithRetry(uploadId, index, blob, signal) {
127:    let lastErr
128:    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= RETRY_MAX; attempt++) {
129:        if (signal && signal.aborted) throw new Error('aborted')
130:        try {
131:            const fd = new FormData()
132:            fd.append('upload_id', uploadId)
133:            fd.append('index', String(index))
134:            fd.append('blob', blob)
135:            const resp = await axios.post(window.$A.apiUrl('upload/chunk'), fd, {
136:                headers: buildHeaders(),
137:                signal,
138:            })
139:            if (resp.data && resp.data.ret === 1) return resp.data.data
140:            lastErr = new Error((resp.data && resp.data.msg) || '分片上传失败')
141:        } catch (e) {
142:            if (signal && signal.aborted) throw e
143:            lastErr = e
144:        }
145:        if (NON_RETRYABLE_MSGS.has(lastErr.message)) throw lastErr
146:        // 指数退避 500ms / 1s / 2s
147:        if (attempt < RETRY_MAX) {
148:            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500 * Math.pow(2, attempt)))
149:        }
150:    }
151:    throw lastErr || new Error('分片重试耗尽')
152:}
153:
154:async function callJson(path, data, signal) {
155:    const resp = await axios.post(window.$A.apiUrl(path), data, {
156:        headers: {
157:            ...buildHeaders(),
158:            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
159:        },
160:        signal,
161:    })
162:    return resp.data
163:}
164:
165:function buildHeaders() {
166:    return {
167:        token: store.state.userToken,
168:        language: languageName,
169:        platform: window.$A.Platform,
170:        version: (window.systemInfo && window.systemInfo.version) || '0.0.1',
171:        fd: window.$A.getSessionStorageString('userWsFd'),
172:    }
173:}
